message: There is a place beside us that only you can fill. Join us as we begin our forever.

events.title: Welcome by the water
events.detail: Meet us on the palm terrace for welcome drinks.

events.title: The wedding ceremony
events.detail: Gather beneath the glasshouse lights for the exchange of vows.

events.title: Dinner under the stars
events.detail: An evening of dinner, music, and dancing on the island.

story.groomLine: I folded the first invitation on our first date. I kept one corner blank.
story.brideLine: He thinks I forgot that night. Watch the harbor when I tip the wings.
story.brideTrait: Knows the islands by their lights
story.sharedMemory: We counted harbor lights until the last ferry left without us.
story.yachtLine: There were two of us counting lights that night. This time we saved one for you.
story.guestLine: We left the last lantern in your hands.
